svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print as one tub, open side up: 261 x 196 x 164.5 mm outside the walls

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (275 x 204 over pads and towers), 3 mm walls and floor. Needs a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: printer bed of at least 300 x 300 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cooling end (right): two pipe slots 10 wide, 25 each side of the centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and a cable slot 6 wide, 40 toward the front, each open at the rim and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ending in a half-round at 114 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pads 14 x 16 x 4 proud on both end faces, 89 each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 40 and 145 up; one M3 heat-set insert in each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two towers 10 x 10 x 10 on the cooling end, 44 each side, 126 up; M3 insert.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle pads 20 dia x 4 at the middle of front and back, 136 up; M5 insert.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Latch pads 20 x 16 x 4 on the front, 72 each side, 142 to 158 up; 2 x M3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set every insert with the soldering iron before any VIP goes in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No screw or drill may ever go through a wall: a VIP sits behind it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the inside is 255 x 190, square, within 0.5 mm.
